2608.08883.title: AquiLLM: An Architecture for Supporting Tacit Knowledge Capture in Research Groups
2608.08883.paper_summary: Recent advances in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and large language models (LLMs) enable researchers to integrate AI into scientific workflows. However, using proprietary commercial AI systems raises concerns about transparency, reproducibility and privacy, which are essential for scientific practices. To this end, AquiLLM was developed as an open-source modular RAG-LLM framework using open-weight models, designed to support research groups in capturing tacit knowledge. In this work, we present a series of architectural improvements and feature enhancements to AquiLLM, including local embedding and reranking, multimodal capabilities, OpenAI-compatible inference interfaces, user interface improvements, semantic and episodic memory capabilities, and skills support. These enhancements were informed by discussions with domain experts, including astrophysicists and environmental researchers, and represent a step toward AI systems more closely aligned with scientific research practices.
2608.08883.paper_summary_zh: 最近在檢索增強生成（RAG）和大型語言模型（LLMs）方面的進展使研究人員能夠將人工智慧整合到科學工作流程中。<lb/>然而，使用專有的商業人工智慧系統引發了對透明度、可重複性和隱私的擔憂，這些對於科學實踐至關重要。<lb/>為此，AquiLLM作為一個開源模組化RAG-LLM框架被開發出來，使用開放權重模型，旨在支持研究團隊捕捉隱性知識。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們提出了一系列對AquiLLM的架構改進和功能增強，包括本地嵌入和重新排序、多模態能力、與OpenAI兼容的推理介面、用戶界面改進、語義和情節記憶能力以及技能支持。<lb/>這些增強是基於與領域專家的討論，包括天體物理學家和環境研究人員，並代表了朝著與科學研究實踐更緊密對齊的人工智慧系統邁出的一步。
